import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def main():
    train_path = "./input/train.csv"
    test_path = "./input/test.csv"
    sample_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"

    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

    # Select feature columns (exclude identifiers)
    feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species"]]

    X = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
    y_cat = train_df["species"].astype("category")

    # Align test features to train feature order
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy().reindex(columns=X.columns)

    # Encode targets
    y = y_cat.cat.codes.values
    classes = y_cat.cat.categories.tolist()

    # Stratified validation split
    X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
    )

    # Initialize XGBoost classifier for multi-class log-loss
    model = XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=5,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        objective="multi:softprob",
        num_class=len(classes),
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=1.0,
        random_state=42,
        verbosity=0,
    )

    # Train model
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

    # Evaluate on validation set
    val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)
    val_score = log_loss(y_val, val_probs, normalize=True)
    print(f"Validation Log-Loss: {val_score:.5f}")

    # Predict on test set
    test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)

    # Construct submission aligned with sample template
    sub_df = sample_sub.copy()
    prob_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=model.classes_, index=sub_df.index)
    sub_df.iloc[:, 1:] = prob_df.values

    # Clip probabilities to [1e-15, 1-1e-15] to match scoring function behavior
    np.clip(sub_df.iloc[:, 1:].values, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15, out=sub_df.iloc[:, 1:].values)

    # Save final submission
    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
    sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
